Followers leave without a trace

Someone who nods along to “the best in the world are run by patterns they can’t see” but isn’t ready for 1:1 has nothing to say yes to. You can’t follow up with people you never captured.

No first purchase

Most of your audience isn’t ready to commit to a coaching engagement on day one. With nothing smaller to buy, they buy nothing, and your 30 years of insight stays locked inside sessions.

Anyone who isn’t ready for 1:1 today leaves with nothing, and you have no way to reach them again.

Sound familiar?

You’re not short of drive. Something keeps getting in the way.

  • The same situations keep producing the same reaction, however hard you try.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Script 1 · “Patterns you can’t see”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The best in the world are run by patterns they can’t see. So are you.”

Body

“I’ve spent 30 years inside elite football. The players who perform under pressure aren’t the ones with the most talent. They’re the ones who know what happens to them when the stakes rise. Leaders are no different.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass for entrepreneurs and leaders. It’s £17, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, plain dark backdrop, on-screen text “patterns you can’t see”.

Script 2 · “The big moment”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Ever known exactly what to do, then done the opposite when it mattered?”

Body

“That isn’t a knowledge problem. It’s a pattern. Pressure doesn’t create it, it reveals it. Once you can see it in the moment, you get a choice you didn’t have before.”

CTA

“In Patterns Under Pressure I’ll show you how to spot yours. Live, 60 minutes, £17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a slide with “knowledge vs pattern”.

Script 3 · “What the dressing room taught me”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“What I learned in elite football dressing rooms that every founder should know.”

Body

“Performing when it counts isn’t about motivation. It’s about having a reset you trust before the big moment, and using it every time. That works the same before a pitch as before a match.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through it in my live masterclass. Seats are £17. Tap Sign up below.”
